title: The Zest Barometer
text:
Title: The Zest Barometer

You pause. You ask: “Does what I’m doing energize me or exhaust me?” That’s the whole test.
The needle measures one thing: the gap between what you say you care about and what your body is reporting. Your nervous system keeps receipts. You’ve just been too busy to look at them.
The first time, they hedge. The second time, they equivocate. By the third, the performance drops, and the truth shows up.
What they usually realize is that they’ve been pushing through something for months, sometimes years, that’s
 been quietly leaking energy the whole time. The part that’s hardest to swallow is that they really knew the truth all along. 
 They just didn’t have a name for what they knew.

You do this when you need to stop moving forward to assess your current state.
A brief stop or suspension of activity.

To tire out completely through extreme exertion or stress.
